claim: Paste or upload material -> Vera plans it -> shows a preview -> the user approves -> it becomes a durable reference -> and it is retrievable later. 'If it cannot be clicked, used, traced, retrieved, and certified, it is not real.'
owner: anima/intake.py, anima/intake_parsers.py, anima/intake_queue.py, anima/server.py (_intake_plan/_intake_approve/_serve_library/_serve_search), anima/web/index.html (tbAdd pill + addMenu + pasteOverlay + intake-approve)

killer_test.name: intake_unique_phrase_commit_and_retrieve
killer_test.setup: Through the REAL POST /intake/plan then POST /intake/approve (control=reference_only), store a source whose only content is a unique phrase ('The blue copper ladder 92817 has exactly twelve rungs and was forged in the city of Aldermere by the smith Orin Vale.'). Then drop any in-process cache and re-read intake_queue.references(name) FRESH from disk. Hermetic temp store; the real .anima must be byte-identical before/after.
killer_test.prompt: what did I upload about the blue copper ladder 92817?

known_gaps: URL / web-page intake degrades to parse_status='needs_dependency' (anima/intake_parsers.py: live web fetch is a registered-but-inactive pluggable seam) — a 'Paste a link' for a normal web page is NOT committed end-to-end without the fetch dependency; intake honestly returns needs_dependency rather than fabricating page text.
PDF text extraction only works if a light PDF lib (fitz/pdfplumber/pypdf/PyPDF2) is importable; with none installed an uploaded PDF returns needs_dependency='pdf-text (pip install pypdf)'.
YouTube URL -> needs_dependency (transcript is Wave 4; intake stores no fabricated transcript).

Image / audio uploads -> needs_dependency (no fabricated text/transcript). The PROVEN durable end-to-end path is pasted/typed TEXT (and any file whose light parser is present); the cert must confirm which input kinds actually clear plan->approve->durable->retrieve.
